The privacy King: Surface Laptop 8 for business review—is the new stealth screen worth the $2,549 entry price?

praises: 15" 3:2 3120x2080 120Hz is a document monster — effectively two side-by-side full pages
Only 1.5 kg for a 15-inch — far lighter than any 15" x86 rival
X2 Elite keeps it silent and cool; battery still comfortably a full day
Bigger chassis means better thermals headroom and a roomier keyboard deck
BF $2,100 pricing undercuts 16" premium ultrabooks with a better panel
complaints: 16GB RAM cap on a 15" productivity machine is genuinely limiting in 2026
Same sparse port set as the 13.8" despite the larger body
ARM app-translation caveats for pro software
Glossy panel; no matte option at any tier
Regular $2,500 price hard to justify vs OLED competitors — mirrors 'hard to recommend' criticism

design_philosophy: The big-screen Surface Laptop: same sealed minimalist design stretched to 15 inches for people who live in documents and split-screen. X2 Elite carries the whole 15" line in Canada — no X Plus tier at this size.
rating_notes: Inferred from SL8 anchor and 13.8" X2 Elite entry: +1.0 screen_size, +0.5 productivity (bigger canvas), -0.5 battery and -1.0 portability for 15"/1.5 kg. Price verified.
